_tuning_notes: Phase 2 economy. money_per_emerald: internal money units one emerald is worth — citizen wealth and every player-facing price convert at this rate. citizen_purse_cap / trader_emerald_float: how many emeralds a citizen actually carries as items (the rest of their wealth stays abstract holdings, so citizens are not an emerald farm). trade_lot: units of a good exchanged per player trade.
